nodes.title: 2026-10-10 main session, as the owner's delegate, on the Kaksha BUILD-SPEC owner questions (docs/design/round4/app/BUILD-SPEC.md §12, claude/r4-app-design @adb399cc). K-O1: G-EN-1 stands, because it is the owner's own directive (owner-design-v2-directive). Chrome renders English only, with no child-facing language switch. The copy table may carry Hinglish and Hindi columns as the dormant localisation parameter the directive's reversal names, but chromeLang is fixed to 'en' in code. Names of places and engines (Kaksha, Antariksh, Khand, Asha) are proper nouns allowed in Latin script (the K-P7 L-HING allowlist). Structure kinds and verbs use English in chrome (stepwell, settlement, For parents, Fire); her speech and captions follow language_pref as today. K-O2: Kaksha Dawn (light tokens, same structure and motion) for the Young family and dark Kaksha for the Older family, keyed on the band family from src/child/band.ts, not the raw class number (a parent's move-up makes a class-4 child Older). This keeps ds-band-fork-older and design-v2-rejected-full-lights-down. K-O3 stays the owner's: the reference phone. Until it arrives every perf number is labelled as a G35-class proxy. K-O4: ui.kaksha never goes past the owner cohort without the five-second child test (TEARDOWN §3.2: 20 class 4-5 and 20 class 7-8, girls included), and running it needs the owner to arrange children and consent. Stream K is the U1 session continuing on its own branch, starting slice K0 on base with the flag off. Equipped cosmetics stay keyed by child id (src/child/prefs.ts already keys taxila.child.<cid>.prefs), with the server pref before 100%. Reverse if: the owner overrides any answer, Hindi-medium children cannot navigate English chrome in the child test (then K-O1 turns on the Hinglish/Hindi columns), or Young children choose dark Kaksha over Dawn in the child test.

2026-10-10 stream 2 (claude/r4-content, local battery on 9da76588): game asks in science and SST lessons have no engine or play family, so they end in her-clause board only. G1 (Antariksh, number line) and G2 (Khand, area/perimeter/views) cover maths. docs/research/round4/games/FEASIBILITY.md already lists candidate science engines over exact laws (predict-run speed, mirrors angle-in = angle-out, shadow fitting, magnets, pendulum T = 2 pi sqrt(L/g), closed circuits, floating and sinking, the water-cycle town). Next: commission a wave-3 science engine stream on G1's core3d@1 once G1 merges. SST has no engine candidate yet and needs a research pass.
